advisories.reason: The affected generic extraction APIs preserve privileged Unix mode bits. Ludusavi does not call ZipArchive::extract or ZipStreamReader::extract and does not restore ZIP permission metadata.
evidence: src/scan/layout.rs:1822-1886: restore_file_from_zip opens a regular destination, reads an entry with by_name and copies its bytes with std::io::copy; only last_modified is applied.
src/scan/layout.rs:1252-1261: unix_permissions is a ZipWriter option used when creating backups, not when restoring them.

advisories.reason: The advisory concerns symbolic-link creation by generic ZIP extraction. The pinned Ludusavi source never calls either generic extraction API or creates links from archive metadata; restore copies entry bytes to a regular file.
evidence: src/scan/layout.rs:921-931: registry ZIP entries are read with by_name and copied into memory.
src/scan/layout.rs:1702-1772,1822-1886: file restores use by_name and std::io::copy instead of generic extraction.
src/scan/layout.rs:2054-2106: backup validation uses by_name only to check entry presence.

advisories.reason: The affected generic extraction APIs apply Unix permissions through links. Ludusavi never calls those APIs, reads ZIP unix_mode metadata or applies ZIP permissions. Its destination readonly adjustment uses existing filesystem metadata, not archive attributes.
evidence: src/scan/layout.rs:1822-1886: manual restore applies entry contents and timestamp only.
src/path.rs:926-951: unset_readonly reads existing destination permissions and adds owner write permission on Unix; no ZIP metadata is involved.
Reviewed the complete pinned src/**/*.rs tree: no generic extract calls, ZipStreamReader use or ZIP unix_mode reads; Cargo.lock has only Ludusavi as a consumer of zip 0.6.6.
